planner.question: Can many disjoint selector restrictions accumulate beyond the linear degree bound, and what sharing cost governs transfer to general circuits?
planner.strategy: Realize arbitrary address truth tables on disjoint guarded pin blocks, then apply a formula restriction count.
planner.alternative: Derive general DAG unfolding size-depth tradeoff and test exponential reuse on parity.
planner.stop_rule: Do not turn a superlinear formula or logarithmic depth bound into an unrestricted superpolynomial circuit lower bound.
literature_leads: Classical Nechiporuk method: Savage Models of Computation section 9.4 https://cs.brown.edu/people/jsavage/book/pdfs/ModelsOfComputation_Chapter9.pdf

construct.claim: The fixed universal 3CNF selector function has formula leaf complexity Omega(N^(4/3)/log N) over arbitrary binary gates.
construct.scope: Disjoint guarded pin selector blocks, explicit width-three mux tree encoding, formula trees with constants and repeated variable leaves.
construct.derivation: Each block realizes 2^m subfunctions; fixed retained formula skeleton has at most 4^(2ell-1) subfunctions; sum leaf costs.
unresolved_steps: Superpolynomial general circuit lower bound; control of shared DAG reuse.
candidate_tests: Exhaust every small address table and partial selector pattern; validate disjoint blocks and formula restrictions.

alternative.claim: General fan-in-two circuits satisfy S*R+1 >= formula bound and depth >= log2 formula bound; linear-size parity DAGs can have exponentially many unfolded copies.
alternative.scope: One output, binary gate DAG, path multiplicity R on internal gates, all binary Boolean functions.
alternative.derivation: Unfold per predecessor use, count directed paths by reverse propagation; diamond recurrence exhibits exponential overhead.
unresolved_steps: Noncircular bound on physical circuit size independent of reuse.
candidate_tests: Build parity diamonds and check actual gate semantics, path counts and unfolded leaves.

objections: Superlinear formula bound is not superpolynomial.
DAG unfolding may be exponential even on parity.
Each outside restriction is block-specific, not one simultaneous assignment.
counterexample_candidates: Parity diamonds with 3k gates and 3*2^k-2 unfolded leaves.
critic.equivalence_audit: Exact block residuals and disjointness; charge each formula leaf once; explicitly count DAG path reuse.
critic.barrier_audit: No unrestricted SAT runtime lower bound or P versus NP resolution.
